title: 第3章 双生初逢第4章 星纹学院入学
lines: 金发考生攥紧手杖，杖头鹰徽磕在白石地面，磕出一粒火星。
洛晖没再理他，顺着铁卫指引走进候考区夜间营帐。
营帐排在选拔场西侧，外层挂着星纹灯，灯芯嵌在铜壳里，每隔十息闪一次。考生分区隔开，贵族营帐铺地毯，平民营帐只有木板床。洛晖分到最角落，靠近废弃观礼廊，廊柱断了三根，石阶上堆着旧旗杆。
铁卫把他推进帐内，丢下一句：“明日白昼正式测试。擅自离帐，按逃犯处置。”
洛晖坐到木板床边，抬起双腕晃了晃抑制环。
“按逃犯处置？我本来不就这个岗位吗？皇城人安排职业规划还挺稳定。”
铁卫掀帘出去。
帐内只剩一盏星纹灯，半明半暗。洛晖摸了摸后颈衣领，指尖捏出那枚暗鹰羽标。羽标细得跟鱼刺差不多，尾端刻着铁卫小印。
“长夏大人送礼真寒酸，连包装都没有。”
把羽标夹进木板缝，拆下床脚松动铜钉，抽出腰带里藏的细铜线，又从破镜盒里抠出三片碎镜。候考营帐规矩多，铁卫搜走了刀具，却没搜走穷人的老本行。
穷人随身带废料，合法，合理，略微气人。
洛晖把铜线绕过帐角木桩，接到星纹灯底部，又把碎镜片卡在床下、帘边、箱盖内侧。只要有人踩进来，铜线牵动镜片，星纹灯残光会打到床头。
布置完，躺回木板床，双手枕在脑后。
七号井，三零七。
洛沉的案卷，在铁卫团最高封库。
铁卫长夏知道编号，黑袍祭司也追过矿道。旧矿坑封门时，洛沉被堵在里面。铁卫、暗影教、父亲，三条线全缠在一起。
投靠铁卫？去给长夏当狗，狗粮里还夹着铁链。
洛晖把黑铁徽片从腰带暗袋摸出来，翻到背面。徽片背面刻着铁卫团鹰盾纹，边角很新。
“拿父亲案吊我胃口。长官，你这钓鱼技术太老，废墟镇水沟里的鱼都不咬。”
星纹灯忽然灭了一半。
帐内暗下来。铜线没有动，帘子也没动。
洛晖右手慢慢垂到床沿，指尖压住床下铜钉。
帐角阴影向内塌陷，黑色裂口在地面无声张开。一只黑靴先踏出来，随后是黑银短发、贴身黑甲、暗纹斗篷。
来人站在床尾，斗篷边缘没有沾灰。腰侧一柄短刃吞着黑火，刃身窄，弧度冷。
洛晖坐起身，抬手打了个招呼。
“半夜钻别人帐篷，皇城礼仪课教得挺野。”
女子没有自报姓名，抬手，暗影之刃抵住洛晖喉侧。
“洛沉留下的火种。”
洛晖手指停在床沿。
“你认识洛沉？”
刃锋往前一分，皮肤被压出浅痕。
“右手伸出来。”
“姑娘，第一次见面就要牵手，进度太快。你们暗影教不讲流程吗？”
女子手腕一转，刃锋贴着他喉侧滑到下颌。
“伸手。”
洛晖慢慢抬起右手，掌心朝上，抑制环压着腕骨。蓝纹在皮肤下缓慢游动，被铁环压得很低。
“你找我爹，找我手。要不要顺便看看我账本？欠款也挺有历史价值。”
女子低头看掌心星纹，另一只手抬起，指尖冒出黑星火。黑火贴近洛晖掌心时，蓝纹猛地亮了一线。
洛晖脚尖轻轻拨动床脚铜线。
床下碎镜片翻起，星纹灯残光被切成三道，照向女子脸侧。
那张脸与白日观赛席上的绮兰极像。轮廓一样，唇线一样，鼻梁一样。只是黑银短发压在颈侧，眉骨下方压着冷硬痕迹，整个人没有贵族席上那套红绸礼裙的修饰。
洛晖眯了眯眼。
“哟，白天坐观赛席，晚上钻影子。你家姐妹业务挺全。”
女子手指一停。
content_en:
The blond examinee clenched his cane tightly and knocked the eagle emblem on the cane's head against the white stone ground, creating a spark.
Luo Hui ignored him and followed the iron guard's guidance into the night tent in the examination waiting area.
The tents are lined up on the west side of the selection field, with star-patterned lamps hanging on the outer layer. The wicks are embedded in the copper shell and flash every ten breaths. Candidates are separated into separate areas. The nobles' tents are covered with carpets, while the civilians' tents only have wooden beds. Luo Hui was assigned to the far corner, close to the abandoned viewing gallery. Three of the pillars were broken, and old flagpoles were piled on the stone steps.
The iron guard pushed him into the tent and said: "The official test will be tomorrow morning. Leaving the tent without authorization will be treated as a fugitive."
Luo Hui sat beside the wooden bed, raised his wrists and shook the suppression ring.
"Treat me as a fugitive? Isn't this my position to begin with? People in the Imperial City have a pretty stable career plan."
Tie Wei opened the curtain and went out.
There was only one star-shaped lamp left in the tent, which was half-lit and half-dark. Luo Hui touched the collar on the back of his neck and took out the dark eagle feather badge with his fingertips. The feather mark is almost as thin as a fish bone, and the tail end is engraved with the small seal of the Iron Guard.
"Mr. Changxia's gift is so shabby, it doesn't even have any packaging."
He clamped the feather badge into the seam of the wooden board, removed the loose copper nails at the foot of the bed, pulled out the thin copper wire hidden in the belt, and dug out three broken mirrors from the broken mirror box. There were many rules in Hou Kao's camp, and the iron guards confiscated the knives, but not the poor man's old business.
It's legal, reasonable, and slightly irritating that poor people carry around scraps.
Luo Hui wrapped the copper wire around the wooden stakes at the corner of the tent and connected it to the bottom of the star pattern lamp. He also stuck the broken lenses under the bed, on the side of the curtain, and on the inside of the box lid. As long as someone steps in, the copper wire will affect the lens, and the residual light of the star pattern lamp will hit the bedside.
After setting up, he lay back on the wooden bed and put his hands behind his head.
Well No. 7, 307.
Luo Chen's case file is sealed at the highest level of the Iron Guard.
Iron Guard Chang Xia knew the number, and the black-robed priest also chased it through the mine tunnel. When the old mine was sealed, Luo Chen was trapped inside. The Iron Guard, the Shadow Cult, and the father, all three threads are intertwined.
Join the Iron Guard? Go and be a dog for Chang Xia, with a chain in the dog food.
Luo Hui took out the black iron badge from the hidden pocket on his belt and turned it to the back. The eagle shield of the Iron Guard is engraved on the back of the emblem, and the corners are very new.
"I'm interested in telling you about my father's case. Sir, your fishing skills are too old. You won't even bite the fish in the ditch of Ruins Town."
Suddenly half of the star pattern lamp went out.
The tent became dark. The copper wire didn't move, and neither did the curtain.
Luo Hui's right hand slowly dropped to the edge of the bed, and his fingertips pressed against the copper nails under the bed.
The shadows at the corners of the tent collapsed inward, and black cracks opened silently on the ground. A black boot stepped out first, followed by black and silver short hair, tight-fitting black armor, and a cloak with dark patterns.
The visitor stood at the end of the bed, the edge of his cloak unstained with dust. A short blade on the side of the waist swallows black fire. The blade is narrow and has a cold arc.
Luo Hui sat up and raised his hand to say hello.
"Sneaking into other people's tents in the middle of the night, the etiquette classes in the Imperial City are quite wild."
The woman did not announce her name. She raised her hand and pressed the shadow blade against the side of Luo Hui's throat.
"The fire left by Luo Chen."
Luo Hui's fingers stopped on the edge of the bed.
"Do you know Luo Chen?"
The blade moved forward, and shallow marks were pressed on the skin.
"Hand out your right hand."
"Girl, we have to hold hands when we meet for the first time. The progress is too fast. Don't you shadow teachers explain the process?"
The woman turned her wrist and the blade slid against the side of his throat to his chin.
"Reach out."
Luo Hui slowly raised his right hand, with his palm facing up, and the restraining ring pressed against his wrist bone. The blue streaks swam slowly under the skin, held down by the iron rings.
"You are looking for my father and my hand. Do you want to take a look at my account book? The arrears are also of historical value."
The woman looked down at the star pattern on her palm, raised her other hand, and black sparks appeared on her fingertips. When the black fire came close to Luo Hui's palm, the blue lines suddenly lit up.
Luo Hui's toes gently moved the copper wire at the foot of the bed.
The broken lens under the bed flipped up, and the remaining light of the star pattern lamp was cut into three rays, shining on the side of the woman's face.
That face was very similar to Qilan who was sitting in the spectator seats during the day. The contours are the same, the lip line is the same, the bridge of the nose is the same. It's just that the short black and silver hair is pressed against the side of the neck, and there is a cold and hard mark under the eyebrow bone. The whole person does not have the decoration of the red silk dress on the aristocratic table.
Luo Hui narrowed his eyes.
"Hey, I sit in the spectator seats during the day and hide in the shadows at night. Your sisters have a very good business."
The woman's fingers paused.
title_en: Chapter 3: Twins Meet for the First Time Chapter 4: Enrollment at Star Pattern Academy
